$comment: DRAFT NICE Plus work role. Not a NIST product. Core/additional flags and added statements are nice-plus judgments, not NIST's. Statements were chosen by relevance to the role, not from coverage tags.
title: Control Room Operator (Cyber-Aware)
description: DRAFT. Operates an industrial process from a control room or HMI and is the first to see many cyber events as process abnormalities. Not a security role: this defines the cybersecurity awareness and response duties an operator needs. NICE has no operator role.

citations.locator: §3.3.5 Establish a Cybersecurity Awareness Training Program for the OT Environment (PDF p. 58)
§3.3.2 Build and Train a Cross-Functional Team (PDF p. 55)
citations.note: Names control system operators as members of the OT cybersecurity team.

open_questions: Is an awareness-level role useful in a workforce framework, or should operator duties be a reusable 'OT cyber awareness' statement set?
Which statements differ between control room operators and field operators?

add_nice.rationale: Inferred: Following the site's cybersecurity policies and procedures.
Inferred: OT safety systems and their role.
Inferred: Recognizing social engineering, a common route into OT.
Inferred: Escalating incidents that may have immediate impact.
Inferred: Awareness of real cyber incidents that affected OT.
